For the State : Mr. Shiv Shankar Kumar, A.P.P.

03/22.03.2023 Heard learned counsel for the parties.

The applicant who is in custody since 16.05.2022 has approached this Court for grant of regular bail in connection with POCSO Case No.61/2022 arising out of Haidernagar P.S. Case No.50/2022,
registered for the offence under Sections 376/ 302/34 of IPC and Sections 4 and 8 of the POCSO Act.
The applicant is an accused of committing rape and murder.
It has been submitted by learned counsel for the applicant(s) that complete set of F.I.R. alongwith its enclosure have been annexed with this bail application and there is no suppression on his part.
Innocence has been claimed and undertaking has been given for participation in the trial.
It has been submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that it is a case of honor killing by the family members and this applicant has been falsely implicated in this case.
Even in the F.I.R., the informant has not disclosed the relationship between the deceased and this applicant.
The so called video prepared wherein the name of this applicant has been taken but not as an assailant.

Further,
the dress has been changed, which is suspicious.
On above basis prayer for bail has been made.
Learned A.P.P. has opposed the prayer for bail of the applicant.

Considering the above fact and the fact that the investigation is complete, the applicant, named above, is directed to be released on bail,
on furnishing bail bonds of Rs.10,000/- (Ten thousand only) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Addl. Sessions Judge-IV, Palamau in connection with POCSO Case No.61/2022 arising out of Haidernagar P.S. Case No.50/2022, subject to the conditions that the applicant will submit self attested copy of his Aadhaar Card and also give his mobile number before the learned court below which he will not change during pendency of this case without prior Shiv Shankar Ram @ Shiv Shankar Kumar vs The State Of Jharkhand .... Opposite ... on 22 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/18194314/
